name: APURV JOSHI
message:
Dear Waffle Castle Team,

I am writing to formally raise a complaint regarding the inconsistent pricing at your Ahmedabad outlets.

I have compared the menu prices at your Ranip, Gota, and Paldi outlets, and they all have the same, lower prices. However, only the Waffle Castle Satellite outlet charges approximately ₹20 to ₹25 more on almost every item.

In addition, the Satellite outlet also provides fewer offers and fewer combo deals compared to your other Ahmedabad outlets.

If the product, quantity, quality, and brand are exactly the same, why are customers at the Satellite outlet being charged more? This pricing policy is unfair and creates an inconsistent customer experience within the same franchise.

I request a clear explanation for this price difference. If there is no valid justification, I expect Waffle Castle to standardize the prices and offers across all Ahmedabad outlets so that customers are treated equally.

I look forward to your prompt response and appropriate action.

Thank you.
